exam.tagline: NACPB's CPB license — three online exams plus verified experience that let you place 'CPB' after your name.
exam.description: The Certified Public Bookkeeper (CPB) license from the National Association of Certified Public Bookkeepers (NACPB) is a U.S. bookkeeping license that lets holders place 'CPB' after their name. It is earned by passing three online certification exams — Bookkeeping, Payroll, and Intuit QuickBooks Online — each 50 multiple-choice questions in two hours at a 75% pass mark, then verifying one year (2,000 hours) of bookkeeping experience and agreeing to the NACPB Code of Professional Conduct. A distinctive feature is that NACPB's individual certifications do not expire, while the CPB license itself renews annually with 24 hours of continuing professional education (CPE). The CPB is a strong fit for bookkeepers who want a license (with verified experience) rather than only a course-based certificate.

exam.prerequisites: There are no strict education prerequisites; you may take the courses and exams without a degree. To obtain the license you must later verify one year (2,000 hours) of bookkeeping experience and agree to the Code of Professional Conduct.
exam.eligibility: The CPB license is open to bookkeepers at any stage. You can substitute the three required courses with an associate or bachelor's degree in accounting (submit transcripts for approval), but you must still pass the three-part Uniform Certified Public Bookkeeper examination. Membership is not required to take courses or exams, but members receive discounts. Candidates who lack qualifying experience can fulfill it through NACPB's bookkeeping experience program.

topics.name: Bookkeeping Certification Exam
topics.note: Accounting as a language, analyzing transactions (T-accounts), journal/ledger, adjustments & worksheet, closing entries, sales/receivables/cash receipts, purchases/payables/cash payments, payroll, accruals/deferrals, financial statements

topics.name: Payroll Certification Exam
topics.note: Payroll practices and systems, gross-pay computations, fringe benefits and voluntary deductions, employee net pay, employer payroll taxes, and the payroll register/accounting entries

topics.name: QuickBooks Online Certification Exam
topics.note: Setting up a company, chart of accounts/lists, daily transactions (sales, expenses, banking), reconciliation, and reporting in QuickBooks Online

topics.note: Verify 1 year (2,000 hours) of bookkeeping experience and agree to the NACPB Code of Professional Conduct to be licensed

faqs.q: How is the CPB license exam structured?
faqs.a: The license is built on three online certification exams — Bookkeeping, Payroll, and Intuit QuickBooks Online — each with 50 multiple-choice questions, a 2-hour limit, and a 75% passing score. Each exam allows up to three attempts, and you can take them after completing (or waiving) the matching course.

Each of the three exams is $80 for NACPB members and $100 for nonmembers (retakes $40/$50). The nonrefundable CPB license processing fee is $100. Course bundles and member discounts reduce the total, so confirm current pricing on nacpb.org.

No — NACPB states its individual certifications do not expire. However, the CPB license does expire annually on December 31 and must be renewed each year with 24 hours of continuing professional education (CPE) and an annual renewal fee.

faqs.q: What experience do I need for the license?
faqs.a: You must verify one year (2,000 hours) of bookkeeping experience performed under appropriate supervision, plus agree to the NACPB Code of Professional Conduct. Candidates without qualifying paid experience may fulfill it through NACPB's bookkeeping experience program.

If you hold an associate or bachelor's degree in accounting, you can submit transcripts for approval to waive the three courses — but you must still pass the three-part Uniform Certified Public Bookkeeper examination and meet the experience and ethics requirements.

summaryPoints: CPB license = three online exams (Bookkeeping, Payroll, QuickBooks), 50 Q each, 75% to pass, plus 1 year verified experience.
NACPB certifications never expire; only the CPB license renews annually (24 CPE hours/year).
Exam fees are $80/$100 each (member/nonmember); the license processing fee is $100.
Accounting-degree holders can waive the courses but must still pass all three exams.

program.body: National Association of Certified Public Bookkeepers (NACPB)
program.about: The National Association of Certified Public Bookkeepers (NACPB) issues the Certified Public Bookkeeper (CPB) license, a U.S. bookkeeping license that verifies knowledge, skill, experience, and ethics. Candidates pass three online certification exams (Bookkeeping, Payroll, QuickBooks Online), verify one year of experience, and agree to the Code of Professional Conduct. NACPB certifications do not expire, while the CPB license renews annually with CPE.

registrationSteps.title: Enroll and complete the courses
registrationSteps.description: Take the Accounting Fundamentals, Payroll Fundamentals, and Intuit QuickBooks Online courses — or waive them with an approved associate/bachelor's degree in accounting (submit transcripts). Membership is optional but gives exam discounts.

registrationSteps.title: Pass the three certification exams
registrationSteps.description: Schedule and pass the Bookkeeping, Payroll, and QuickBooks Online certification exams online — 50 multiple-choice questions, 2 hours, 75% to pass, up to three attempts each.

registrationSteps.title: Verify your experience
registrationSteps.description: Document one year (2,000 hours) of bookkeeping experience with the Work Experience Verification form signed by your employer or client(s). The NACPB experience program can substitute for paid experience.

registrationSteps.title: Agree to the Code of Conduct
registrationSteps.description: Review and agree to abide by the NACPB Code of Professional Conduct as part of the license application.

registrationSteps.title: Submit the license application
registrationSteps.description: Email the completed application forms to NACPB with the $100 nonrefundable processing fee. NACPB verifies experience and may audit.

registrationSteps.title: Renew the license annually
registrationSteps.description: Each year complete 24 hours of approved CPE and submit the annual license renewal application (and fee) by December 31 to keep the CPB active.

program.proctoring: The NACPB certification exams are delivered online after course completion; they are not administered at third-party testing centers. The CPB license itself is granted on verified experience and the Code of Conduct rather than a single proctored sitting.
program.retakePolicy: Each certification exam allows up to three (3) attempts. If you do not pass, retakes cost $40 for NACPB members and $50 for nonmembers per exam.
program.recertification: NACPB certifications do not expire. The CPB license, however, expires December 31 each year and must be renewed annually by completing 24 hours of approved continuing professional education (CPE) and submitting the annual renewal application and fee.
program.scoreReporting: Exam results are scored electronically and provided immediately after completion. License status and CPE reporting are tracked through your NACPB account.
program.refundPolicy: The $100 CPB license processing fee is nonrefundable. NACPB also offers a 14-day refund on many course and exam purchases if you are not satisfied (see the NACPB refund policy).
program.providersNote: NACPB operates alongside its sister school, Consortia Accounting School, which accredits the CPB license and offers the all-in-one CPB Program (bundled education, exams, training, experience, and application). Exams are NACPB-delivered online, not via an external vendor.

orgFaqs.a: No. NACPB states its certifications do not expire. Only the CPB license expires annually and must be renewed each year with 24 CPE hours and a renewal fee.

orgFaqs.q: Is the CPB license the same as a course certificate?
orgFaqs.a: No. A certification confirms knowledge in one area (e.g., Bookkeeping). The CPB license requires all three certifications plus verified experience and the Code of Conduct, and it lets you use the 'CPB' title.

orgFaqs.q: Can I get the license without a degree?
orgFaqs.a: Yes. There is no degree requirement; you complete the three courses (or waive them with an accounting degree) and verify one year of bookkeeping experience. NACPB's experience program can substitute for paid experience.
